items.source: Creates a new InvalidPersistentPropertyPath for the given resolved path and message.
items.translation: 为给定的解析路径和消息创建一个新的InvalidPersistentPropertyPath。

items.source: Returns the part of the source path until which the source property path could be resolved.
items.translation: 返回源路径中可解析源属性路径的部分。

items.source: Returns the type the source property path was attempted to be resolved on.
items.translation: 返回尝试解析源属性路径的类型。

items.source: Returns the segment of the source property path that could not be resolved.
items.translation: 返回源属性路径中无法解析的部分。

items.source: Exception to indicate a source path couldn't be resolved into a PersistentPropertyPath completely.
items.translation: 异常，表示无法将源路径完全解析为PersistentPropertyPath。

items.source: unresolvableSegment - must not be null or empty.
resolvedPath - must not be null or empty.
the source will never be null.
items.translation: 源对象永远不会为 null。

items.source: the type will never be null.
items.translation: 该类型永远不会为 null。
